dct_creator_sm: Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) / Environnement et Changement climatique Canada (ECCC).
dct_description_sm:
The Monitoring and Surveillance of Freshwater Quality in the St. Lawrence Watershed Program is conducted by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) as well as through the Agreement between Canada and Quebec for Water Quality Monitoring and the St. Lawrence Action Plan in order to assess the state of water quality and long-term trends, to detect emerging problems, to establish water quality recommendations and to monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions and regulatory decisions 

The Freshwater Quality Monitoring and Surveillance Program in the St. Lawrence River watershed is conducted by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) and through the Canada-Quebec Water Quality Monitoring Agreement and the St. Lawrence Action Plan to assess the state of water quality and long-term trends, detect emerging trends, detect emerging problems, establish water quality guidelines, and track the effectiveness of remedial actions and regulatory decisions.

Le programme de Monitoring et surveillance de la qualité de l’eau douce dans le bassin versant du Saint-Laurent est mené par Environnement et Changement climatique Canada (ECCC) ainsi qu'à travers l'Entente entre le Canada et le Québec pour le monitoring  de la qualité de l'eau et le Plan d'action Saint-Laurent afin d'évaluer l'état de la qualité de l'eau et les tendances à long terme, de détecter les problèmes émergents, d'établir les recommandations pour la qualité de l'eau et de suivre l'efficacité des mesures correctrices et des décisions réglementaires. 

The Freshwater Quality Monitoring and Surveillance Program in the St. Lawrence River watershed is conducted by Environment and Climate Change Canada (ECCC) and through the Canada-Québec Water Quality Monitoring Agreement and the St. Lawrence Action Plan to assess the state of water quality and long-term trends, detect emerging problems, establish water quality guidelines, and track the effectiveness of remedial actions and regulatory decisions.
